text:
Priya: Quick sync from vendor lane: partners are asking for a concise fallback and embargo plan for H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi/B200 SKUs. Need a one-pager and a machine-readable policy for marketplace ingestion.
Ethan: Ill take the policy draft. High-level thought: split by workload profile rather than strict device order to avoid big latency regressions.
Ravi: Agree. My draft tiers: interactive -> h100,h200,mi300-q ; batch -> mi300,gaudi,b200 ; long-context -> mi300,h200.
Sofia: Also add `honor_reserved=true` so Dedicated pools aren't auto-failed-over. We can't touch committed capacity.
NVIDIA-PartnerEng: Tentative H200 GA mid-July; we'll confirm exact ship windows next Tue. Embargo policy: partner preview 14 days after final image acceptance.
AMD-PartnerEng: MI300 schedule still a little soft; we can do partner previews ~10 days after we accept the final image tag. Tag format we prefer: `redwood-<model>-<gpu>-v<semver>`.
Priya: Marketplace requirement: a `sku_list` string like `gpu:h100,h200,mi300,gaudi,b200` and a `capabilities.json` file mapping slugs to flags (kv_cache, max_seq, quant_support). Also 14-day image-bake lead time.
Ethan: Example policy blob for partners (small):
```json
{
  "policy":"fallback_v0.1",
  "profiles":{
    "interactive":["h100","h200","mi300_q4"],
    "batch":["mi300","gaudi","b200"],
    "long_context":["mi300","h200"]
  },
  "honor_reserved":"true",
  "embed_lead_time_days":"14"
}
```
Ravi: Ops note: quant flags differ across SKUs. Add `preferred_quant` in the capabilities map so infra can pick kernels correctly. For MI300 low-precision path recommend 4-bit for cost-sensitive batch workloads.
Sofia: I'll draft the one-pager for partners and add embargo placeholders. We should sequence: internal partner alert -> partner preview (embargoed) -> marketplace pre-announce -> public joint blog.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: manifest must include `sku_list` and `capabilities.json` for automated bake. Auto-bake scheduled when manifest PR merges.
Priya: Action items: @NVIDIA-PartnerEng share firm ship windows by Tue; @Ethan produce PR with policy and test vectors; @Ravi create `sku_capabilities.csv` (slug,max_seq,preferred_quant,notes); @Sofia draft comms and embargo calendar.
Ethan: I'll include a small test plan with latency and throughput smoke tests. Will condition fallback rules to only trigger on non-reserved traffic.
Ravi: Will coordinate with infra to spin a small MI300+Gaudi cluster for throughput verification. ETA for smoke runs: 3 days after infra confirms nodes.
AMD-PartnerEng: We'll try to push final tags by Tue EOD; will confirm exact partner-preview window then.
Priya: Great. We should avoid customer-facing comms until vendors confirm embargo windows. Ill hold the public announce draft until dates land.
Sofia: Adding calendar invites for partner preview review once tags/dates are in.
MarketplaceBot: Note: marketplace validation will fail if `capabilities.json` missing fields `max_seq` or `sku_list`.
Ethan: Cool. Ill open the PR tonight with the policy JSON + simple unit tests.
Priya: Thanks all 44d. Follow-up in this thread after vendor dates.
